content: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visitor v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit vi JOIN museum m ON vi.Museum_ID = m.Museum_ID WHERE vi.visitor_ID = v.ID AND m.Open_Year > '2010')
